entities.name: Dromton Gyelwa Jungne
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dromtön, Drom Tonpa or Dromtönpa Gyelwé Jungné was the chief disciple of the Buddhist master Atiśa, the initiator of the Kadam school of Tibetan Buddhism and the founder of Reting Monastery.
